ash: edr-bot quarantined a Chrome extension on my laptop this morning. I noticed a new toolbar called 'TabTune' I didn't install. device: ash-mbp.local :confused:
edr-bot: ALERT 1845556667 | severity: medium | detection: PUA.Chrome.Extension | action: quarantined | device: ash-mbp.local | artifact: com.crx.TabTune | sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924 | network domains: cdn.tabtune[.]io ; callback: no
lee: @ash can you confirm if you use any dev tools that install extensions? also pinging @mika-security for visibility :eyes:
ash: nope, I only use the standard extensions (adblock, password-manager). saw the EDR popup while coding. attaching screenshot in thread. should I disconnect wifi?
mika: good catch. first steps: 1) disconnect from corp VPN/wifi (airplane mode) if possible 2) don't reboot 3) run a full EDR scan and upload the results here 4) we'll pull the EDR quarantine package and analyze the CRX. if we see persistence, plan for a reimage.
lee: run these two commands and paste output (mac):
```
sudo /opt/edr/edrctl scan --full --output json
/opt/edr/edrctl quarantine list --device ash-mbp.local
```
ash: running now, output attached. scan finished: no additional detections, only TabTune CRX quarantined. quarantine list shows entry id 78f4ea with verdict quarantine.
mika: thanks. I'll pick up the quarantine bundle and check vendor signing + embedded scripts. if it's unsigned or contacting trackers, we'll treat as PUA. also: @ash did you log into any internal tooling in the last 24h from that laptop? if yes, rotate session tokens for safety.
ash: I used my laptop for PR reviews and the staging dashboard this morning. i'll rotate my GitHub and staging API tokens now, thanks.
lee: good. I'll schedule a deeper forensic check on the device later today (memory, autoruns) and mark the ticket 'monitoring'. if we don't find indicators of compromise after 24h, we'll close as contained.
mika: agree. action items: - mika -> analyze CRX bundle (ETA 3h) - lee -> forensic check and host timeline (ETA EOD) - ash -> rotate credentials, keep device offline until cleared :thumbsup:
ash: got it. thanks team.
edr-bot: NOTE: follow-up scan scheduled in 24h (1845643067) by auto-remediation policy.
lee: leaving a short note to incident log: "EDR quarantined PUA Chrome extension on ash-mbp; contained; no further detections as of initial full scan; creds rotated by user; follow-up scan in 24h." :white_check_mark:
